runner_factors.note: Multiplies every desktop limit for a known-slow machine. CI runners use the default.

metrics.name: Window to first paint (desktop)
metrics.baseline_machine: Windows 11 dev machine, offscreen (date not recorded in the table; see PLAN.md U11)
metrics.note: MainWindow() + show() to first paint. Limit about 2.5x the baseline (U11).

metrics.name: Open 1000 pages to a painted page (desktop)
metrics.baseline_machine: Windows 11 dev machine, offscreen (date not recorded in the table; see PLAN.md U11)
metrics.note: Open the 1000-page document to a painted page. Limit about 2.5x the baseline (U11).

metrics.name: Scroll frame at 1000 pages (desktop)
metrics.baseline_machine: Windows 11 dev machine, offscreen (date not recorded in the table; see PLAN.md U11)
metrics.note: One 60 fps frame per scroll step and repaint.

metrics.name: Theme switch (desktop)
metrics.baseline_machine: Windows 11 dev machine, offscreen (date not recorded in the table; see PLAN.md U11)
metrics.note: Light and dark with a document open. Limit about 2.5x the baseline (U11).

metrics.name: Save of 1000 pages after one edit (desktop)
metrics.note: PROVISIONAL, trend only (enforce false): the 8000 ms limit is a placeholder, not measured, so the test records samples but does not assert. Record a Windows dev baseline, set the limit to about 2.5x it, then set enforce to true.

metrics.name: First-load gzip bytes (web build)
metrics.note: PROVISIONAL label (no timing baseline; W1 counts bytes). The 40 MB decimal hard limit is enforced by the exit code of web/app/scripts/check-size.ts, run by web-pytest.yml on every web PR, not by this table's enforce flag. web/app/src/deploy/budget.ts must carry the same limit.

metrics.name: Repeat visit to page 1 (Pyodide start + import + open + paint)
metrics.stat: median of 5 after a warm-up, compared with the baseline commit run in the same job
metrics.note: PROVISIONAL: HEAD fails only when it is more than 15% AND more than 300 ms slower than the baseline_ref build (src/perf/compare.ts). Not gated until web-perf (W8.3 S4b) runs it; then set enforce to true.

metrics.name: First visit (cold profile)
metrics.note: PROVISIONAL, trend only (enforce false): depends on the network, so it is reported and never gated.

metrics.name: Longest main-thread task while scrolling end to end
metrics.note: PROVISIONAL: the 50 ms limit (W1.4 section 14) is not yet measured on a CI runner, so the rule is not enforced (enforce false) until a baseline run is recorded.

metrics.name: Page sharp after scrolling stops
metrics.note: PROVISIONAL, trend only (enforce false): the target is for a mid-range laptop, so it is reported and never gated.
